class.name: GameplayReplicationProperty
class.description: Describes one value managed by [GameplayReplicationState]. Conditions are evaluated from server-owned connection and gameplay ownership data; a client-provided owner claim is never authoritative.

members.member: Controls which admitted connections receive the value.
Stable name used in replication updates.
Emits the state notification after a newer remote value changes the local value.
Minimum interval between updates sent to the same peer. Zero disables throttling.

constants.constant: Sends initial and dirty values to every admitted peer.
Sends the current value once for each peer registration.
Sends only to the server-recorded gameplay owner.
Sends to admitted peers other than the server-recorded gameplay owner.
